On every screen

One player for every device you own.

The same engine, libVLC, runs on your desktop, your phone and your TV. If it plays on one, it plays on all of them.

VLC · Windows

  • Hardware decoding with Direct3D 11, HDR10 and 10-bit
  • From Windows XP SP3 to Windows 11, on x64, ARM64 and x86
  • Portable ZIP, MSI for IT, or the Microsoft Store
Get VLC for Windows

VLC · macOS

  • Native on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
  • VideoToolbox acceleration for H.264 and HEVC
  • Runs on macOS 10.7.5 and every release since
Get VLC for macOS

VLC · Linux

  • Packaged by every major distribution
  • VA-API and VDPAU decoding, Wayland and X11
  • Also on Flathub and the Snap Store
Get VLC for Linux

VLC · Android

  • Phones, tablets, Chromebooks and Android TV
  • Media library, network shares and remote access
  • Free on Google Play and F-Droid
Get VLC for Android

VLC · iPhone & iPad

  • Wi-Fi sharing, SMB, NFS, SFTP and UPnP
  • CarPlay, Siri and A-to-B playback
  • Plays files no other iOS app will
Get VLC for iPhone & iPad

VLC · Apple TV

  • Designed for the Siri Remote
  • Stream from your NAS in the original format
  • HD audio passthrough to your receiver
Get VLC for Apple TV

What’s new · 3.0.24

130+security fixesRelease notes

VLC 3.0.24 is the biggest security update in years.

  • FFmpeg upgraded from 4.4 to 8.1, plus 49 updated libraries
  • ATRAC3 and ATRAC9 decoding
  • CEA-708 closed captions in MP4
  • SRT listener mode and SFTP public-key login
  • Faster Windows start-up when the clocks change
  • Update checks signed with a new RSA-4096 key

Hidden talents

Things you didn’t know VLC could do.

FAQ

Convert any file

Media › Convert / Save turns a video into MP4, WebM or MP3.

Record your screen

Open a capture device, choose Desktop, and press record.

Rescue broken files

VLC rebuilds damaged AVI indexes and plays incomplete downloads.

Change the speed

Press [ and ] to slow down or speed up, with the pitch kept natural.

Snap a frame

Shift+S (⌥⌘S on Mac) saves the current frame as an image.

Stream to your network

Media › Stream sends any file to other devices at home.
